purpose: Current source-to-IA static conformance for the existing P6-2 physical denominator. This does not make a business, cleanup or L2 claim.
screenReadbackPolicy: For every entry, the cited IA section is the business task, actor/scenario, entry/surface, visible control and accessibility truth; the physical contract is the consumer/foundation truth; the roster is the generated-operation, typed-failure, owner-readback and focused-proof truth. Each consumer was reopened against all three. All controls require testId and accessible native/pro-component labels; data/candidate changes must clear dependent state; typed owner failures retain only non-secret drafts; unknown submits read owner state before replay.
